name: Trebor the Fallen Hero
shortDescription: Trebor the Fallen Hero, represented in the Classic research story.
body: A spectral human warrior, the Fallen Hero of the Horde. The art emphasizes age, grief and the outline of a soldier; its exact armor and body details remain interpretive. This is original interpretive art, not canonical game art or evidence for exact appearance, location, or event. See the story's visual asset ledger for the matching-build review gate.
